parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
You are provided with a container of water and a piece of modelling clay which can
be moulded into a cylindrical piston.
You are also provided with a card on which is written the internal diameter d of the
container, together with two other values A and B.
Mould the piece of modelling clay into a cylinder with a diameter approximately
equal to value A.
Measure and record the diameter d of this cylinder.
d = ______
